爱莎贝儿-140CM-M 粉肤 RAD021 水城理沙Mizuki Risa-粘人的蛇娘
刚化成人形的她还带着点软软的无力，赤足踩在地上，立刻又把身子贴紧他胸口，双手环住他的腰，脸颊埋进他颈窝轻轻蹭着。
“主人……人形也好想一直黏着你。”她声音软糯，微微踮起脚，把整个人更用力地依进他怀里，指尖悄悄扣住他衣角不放。
身型：140CM-M 粉肤

Elsa Babe-140CM-M Pink RAD021 Mizuki Risa-The Clingy Snake Girl
Having just transformed into human form, she was still a little weak and limp. Barefoot, she immediately pressed herself against his chest, wrapping her arms around his waist and burying her face in his neck, gently nuzzling him.
"Master... I want to stay with you forever even in human form." Her voice was soft and sweet. She slightly tiptoed, pressing herself even closer to him, her fingertips secretly gripping the hem of his clothes.
Body type: 140CM-M with Pink skin tone.
